Example schema and alternatives from the football red cards study

Source: R/utils.R
example_football_grp5.Rd

The schema extracted from Team 5's reported methodology in the many-analysts study, and a set of alternatives for one of its steps. Both are read from files shipped with the package, so they are real rather than invented – see football_grp5 for the prose the schema came from.

example_football_grp5_alternatives() overrides specify_random_effects_structure with the three random-effects specifications the team considered (gm1, gm2, gm3), so expanding it gives four branches.

Usage

example_football_grp5()

example_football_grp5_alternatives()

Value

  • example_football_grp5() returns a schema.

  • example_football_grp5_alternatives() returns an alternatives object.

See also

football_grp5 for the methodology text, and example_hdi() for the smaller invented examples.

Examples

schema <- example_football_grp5()
alts <- example_football_grp5_alternatives()

expand_tines(schema, alts)
#> A multiverse with 4 schemas:
#>   original: (7 steps)
#>   gm1: (7 steps)
#>   gm2: (7 steps)
#>   gm3: (7 steps)
